name: Day planner
description: Your daily note's plan as a timeline: list items that start with a time (- 09:00 - 10:30 Standup) become blocks on the day, with a line at the time it is now.

day-planner.description: the note's timed list items (- [ ] 09:00 - 10:30 Standup, - 14:00 Lunch) as a timeline of the day; one without an end lasts until the next

start.description: the first hour shown (left out: 8, or earlier for an earlier item)

end.description: the last hour shown (left out: 18, or later for a later item)
